entries.title: Product identity
entries.description: Reusable headless commerce framework and SaaS offering; separate the commercial engine from the Control Plane; independent installation is a progressive goal.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Initial operating model
entries.description: Start on shared multi-tenant infrastructure, with dedicated deployments as a future possibility.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Company and brand
entries.description: A company may operate multiple stores with separate or shared catalogs.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Frontend independence
entries.description: Expose backend functionality through frontend-agnostic APIs and SDKs; Angular is the reference frontend.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Customization
entries.description: Use validated configuration and interface-based adapters; prohibit arbitrary tenant-supplied executable code.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Product scope
entries.description: Support both digital and physical goods in the product vision; the initial vertical is digital.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Buyer model
entries.description: Keep commercial buyer profiles isolated per company, potentially linked to a common technical identity.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Source availability
entries.description: Use a public open-source repository; the precise license is still only a proposal, with Apache-2.0 a candidate.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: First delivery
entries.description: Deliver an evolvable deployable MVP; do not equate a demo with certified production or real-sales readiness.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Developer environment
entries.description: Prefer WSL2/Linux and VS Code.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Repository organization
entries.description: Use a coordinated monorepo with Nx and pnpm.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Primary objective
entries.description: Favor deep architectural learning and verifiable production-oriented evidence over development speed.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Tenant hierarchy
entries.description: A Tenant owns distinct Brands and Stores with explicitly governed associations.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Shared catalogs
entries.description: Share product and variant definitions; publication, prices and stock are store-scoped; share pools only through explicit allocations.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Master and local catalogs
entries.description: Support tenant master references and store-local products with ownership and controlled overrides.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Cross-tenant isolation
entries.description: Allow explicit import or copy only; never expose cross-tenant private references.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Channels
entries.description: A Store supports multiple storefronts and sales channels; interface and channel are separate concepts.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Customers
entries.description: Commercial profiles are store-scoped; linking to shared technical identity requires explicit authorization.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Attributes
entries.description: Use typed, validated and versioned tenant-specific attribute schemas.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Offers and inventory
entries.description: Prices belong to offers/channels; stock belongs to locations/pools and may be shared only under control.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: eGame reference vertical
entries.description: The first vertical sells individual activation keys through secured access and idempotent operations.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Extensible checkout
entries.description: Preserve a common flow and shared invariants while allowing replaceable policies and strategies.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Distribution objective
entries.description: Distribute npm packages and an independently installable backend through Docker/Helm, validated progressively with external consumers.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Configuration isolation
entries.description: Persist configuration and deploy adapters through the platform; third-party code must not execute inside SaaS tenant isolation.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Initial topology
entries.description: Start with a modular commercial core and independent integrations; later extraction of bounded contexts is mandatory.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Angular storefront
entries.description: Provide a reusable storefront with themes, configuration and extensions while keeping the APIs frontend-independent.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: SKU identity
entries.description: Make SKU unique within its namespace/catalog and maintain a stable internal global identifier.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Local product
entries.description: Keep an explicit link to the master product and governed overrides.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Attribute inheritance
entries.description: Propagate individual fields based on versioned inheritance policies.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Listing versus Offer
entries.description: Listing governs publication and visibility; Offer governs commercial sale terms.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Money
entries.description: Use exact minor units with currency rules and exact decimal intermediate calculations; never use binary floating-point amounts.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Checkout price acceptance
entries.description: Reprice and display changes before acceptance, then persist an immutable accepted economic snapshot.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Promotions
entries.description: Defer promotions beyond the first MVP and use standard prices initially.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Taxation
entries.description: Expose a tax port and demonstration adapter that is explicitly unsuitable for real taxation.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Inventory pool
entries.description: Model StockPool capacity, individual units or quantities and commercial allocations.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Shared pools
entries.description: Support configurable shared capacity or protected store quotas.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Initial reservation
entries.description: Use a time-limited reservation with an initial 15-minute default; do not confuse it with the external payment window.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Insufficient stock
entries.description: Reject the entire checkout if capacity is missing; do not support ordinary partial purchases or backorders initially.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Guest cart
entries.description: Persist guest carts authoritatively in the backend and protect access through secure tokens.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Checkout isolation
entries.description: Each checkout belongs to exactly one store; never mix tenants.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Checkout coordination
entries.description: Use a durable purchase saga with recoverable compensation and reconciliation.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Late payment
entries.description: Specify explicit expiration, unknown and pending financial results; the historical P0-01 remains the initial design risk.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Stripe
entries.description: Use hosted Stripe Checkout and Stripe Connect in test mode; exact Connect model depends on further decisions.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Final payment evidence
entries.description: Require verified provider events and reconciliation rather than browser redirects; use persistent idempotency.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Refund demonstration
entries.description: Support a complete test-mode administrative refund.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Failure after capture
entries.description: Persist saga repair/retry work and refund if fulfillment truly cannot be completed.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Digital-key allocation
entries.description: Reserve commercial capacity before payment; assign the actual license only after confirmed payment.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Secret protection
entries.description: Use authenticated encryption, managed keys and auditable access.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: License disclosure
entries.description: Reveal licenses only through controlled authenticated access; emails are notices, not license delivery channels.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Physical-goods path
entries.description: Design contract boundaries now; implement physical fulfillment in a later phase.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Starting topology
entries.description: Use a modular NestJS core with separate workers and progressive service extraction.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Control Plane independence
entries.description: Deploy CommerceCloud separately from CommerceCore.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Integration processes
entries.description: Consider Outbox Publisher, Payment Integration and Notifications as separate execution processes; Payment Integration is not the Payments domain aggregate.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Mandatory extraction
entries.description: Extract Catalog, Payments, Inventory and Ordering with defined comparative metrics and acceptance gates.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Public APIs
entries.description: Use REST and OpenAPI.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Backend-for-frontend
entries.description: Keep gateway and Storefront/Admin BFF distinct and free from fundamental business ownership.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Internal HTTP
entries.description: Use versioned REST between executable services and local ports inside one runtime.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Asynchronous messaging
entries.description: Use Kafka for events once introduced; use synchronous contracts where immediate responses are necessary.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Data ownership
entries.description: Keep collections private by bounded context; isolate databases and credentials after extraction.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Event contracts
entries.description: Use JSON Schema and a common versioned event envelope.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Compatibility
entries.description: Version contracts and require conformance and compatibility tests.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Reliable delivery
entries.description: Assume at-least-once processing with transactional Outbox, Inbox and idempotent effects.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Resilience
entries.description: Specify timeouts, bounded backoff, selective circuit breakers and explicit failure modes.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Horizontal scalability
entries.description: Keep HTTP services stateless and replicable; control concurrent workers.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Deployable versions
entries.description: Version images and releases independently without breaking dependent clients.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Environments
entries.description: Use local Compose, Kubernetes labs and cloud only when the milestone calls for them.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: GitHub ownership
entries.description: Use a dedicated CommerceCore GitHub organization as the historical proposal, with a public repository; current actual owner is sergio-tr.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Branching model
entries.description: Historically selected trunk-based development with PRs and release branches as needed; see newer accepted branch-governance policy for the current feature/bugfix rule.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Workspace
entries.description: Use Nx and pnpm workspaces with a package.json for each project.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Package boundaries
entries.description: Organize by bounded context and Domain/Application/Adapters without arbitrary fragmentation.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Architectural enforcement
entries.description: Enforce import boundaries through ESLint, Nx tags and CI architecture tests.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Public packages
entries.description: Publish only explicitly public SDK, contracts and framework components; keep internals private.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: NestJS isolation
entries.description: Use pure TypeScript in Domain/Application and keep NestJS decorators/DI in composition and adapters.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Contract-first validation
entries.description: Use OpenAPI, JSON Schema and Ajv; do not treat transport DTOs as domain entities.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Runtime candidate
entries.description: Node 24 LTS is a selected candidate; pin actual runtime and lockfile compatibility at project start.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Frontend packages
entries.description: Provide Angular shell, shared commerce UI and application-specific features.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Frontend state
entries.description: Prefer Signals and services, using RxJS when it provides value.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: SDK generation
entries.description: Generate TypeScript SDKs reproducibly from OpenAPI; other languages later.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Unit testing
entries.description: Prefer Vitest, with adapter-specific alternatives when necessary.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Integration testing
entries.description: Use Testcontainers for MongoDB/Kafka and executable contract checks.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: End-to-end and load
entries.description: Use Playwright and k6.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: CI strategy
entries.description: Use GitHub Actions, Nx affected and mandatory non-skippable global checks.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Versioning
entries.description: Use Changesets for npm packages; apply a separate policy for application/container releases.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Documentation governance
entries.description: Practice docs-as-code with ADRs, C4 diagrams, issues and test traceability.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Local Mongo
entries.description: Use a simplified replica set even in Compose; it is not high availability.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Persistence boundaries
entries.description: Initially share commerce_db with private collections per context; CommerceCloud has separate persistence.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Tenant filtering
entries.description: Use trusted TenantContext on shared documents and explicit cross-tenant testing.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Index design
entries.description: Design indexes from queries and scoped uniqueness, not a universal tenantId prefix.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Database adapter
entries.description: Use the official MongoDB driver behind repositories and ports.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Transaction strategy
entries.description: Prefer single-document atomicity; use selective local multi-document transactions only when essential; never hold transactions across external calls.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Schema migration
entries.description: Use versioned idempotent expand–migrate–contract migrations.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Backups
entries.description: Encrypt backups, store copies externally, define retention and test real restoration.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Redis ownership
entries.description: Use Redis only for justified ephemeral functions, never authoritative financial truth.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Cache strategy
entries.description: Use cache-aside, TTL, invalidation, fallback and stampede controls.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Cart persistence
entries.description: Persist authoritative carts in MongoDB; Redis may accelerate reads.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Redis failure
entries.description: Fall back safely for noncritical reads or fail explicitly for critical controls, never generally fail-open.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Kafka topology
entries.description: Use KRaft for Compose, Strimzi for K8s lab, managed Kafka later only when economically justified.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Topic boundaries
entries.description: Use topics by bounded context or flow rather than one per event or one monolithic topic.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Ordering key
entries.description: Partition by aggregate or the entity requiring ordering; no global cross-topic ordering guarantee.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Schema evolution
entries.description: Use JSON Schema and automated compatibility checks; Schema Registry may follow.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Outbox publication
entries.description: Consider polling with leasing/fencing tokens, Kafka ACK and recovery; Change Streams are later candidates.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Inbox handling
entries.description: Persist deduplication and the local effect atomically where applicable.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Retries and DLQ
entries.description: Bound retry/backoff, use retry topics, DLQ and authorized replay.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Rebuild semantics
entries.description: Use Kafka only within retention and rebuild from persistent authority; do not impose universal event sourcing.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Sharding approach
entries.description: Start with replica sets; investigate per-collection shard keys in a later lab.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Service extraction
entries.description: Use expand–migrate–contract with exactly one authoritative writer after cutover.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Read projections
entries.description: Accept eventual projections with versioning, checkpoints, measurable lag and repair.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Chaos testing
entries.description: Reproduce crashes, partitions, duplicates, recovery and restoration.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Identity realms
entries.description: Separate B2B administration from B2C buyers.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Tenant membership
entries.description: CommerceCloud owns tenants/memberships and recoverably synchronizes Keycloak Organizations.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: BFF authentication
entries.description: Use Authorization Code/PKCE, HttpOnly sessions, server-side tokens, CSRF and validated callback domains.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Buyer identities
entries.description: Reuse B2C technical identity but keep commercial profiles store-scoped.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Authorization model
entries.description: Apply RBAC and ABAC to tenant, store, actor, resource and action.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Identity authority
entries.description: Keycloak authenticates; CommerceCloud governs commercial memberships and policies.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: TenantContext
entries.description: Resolve and authorize tenant context at a trusted boundary; authenticate its internal propagation.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Support privilege
entries.description: Explicit time-limited privilege elevation with least privilege and audit.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: MFA
entries.description: Require MFA for administration; apply risk-based MFA to buyers.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Guest order claims
entries.description: Use single-use expiring links, verification, authenticated account and atomic binding.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Revocation
entries.description: Use short sessions, revocation and revalidation for critical operations.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Active membership
entries.description: Select active tenant explicitly; never merge privileges across tenants.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Workload credentials
entries.description: Use OAuth2 client credentials with audience/scopes; these do not replace delegated buyer authorization.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Network security
entries.description: Enforce actual deny-by-default NetworkPolicies and suitable TLS.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Ingress protection
entries.description: Use Cloudflare WAF/rate limits and complementary Gateway/API/origin protection.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Secret management
entries.description: Use an external secret manager and K8s integration; keep secrets outside Git.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: License cryptography
entries.description: Use envelope encryption (KEK/DEK), versioning and access audit; exact cryptographic design pending.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Privacy
entries.description: Minimize, differentiate retention, and delete/anonymize according to applicable obligations.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Audit integrity
entries.description: Build append-only records with verifiable integrity; a database collection is not automatically immutable.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Security CI
entries.description: Add SAST, SCA, secret scanning, container scanning and authorization tests.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Object and function authorization
entries.description: Automate BOLA/BFLA matrices by tenant, store, role, buyer, resource and API.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Lab infrastructure
entries.description: Use local k3d, VPS k3s and Compose as the primary development environment.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Cloud comparison
entries.description: Start with self-managed VPS and later compare managed Kubernetes.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Environment scope
entries.description: Separate Compose development, Kubernetes lab and possible future production.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Availability
entries.description: Do not claim initial high availability; schedule multi-node experiments later.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Gateway
entries.description: Evaluate Envoy Gateway over Gateway API while avoiding accidental k3s Traefik conflicts.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Load balancers
entries.description: Use native provider LBs when available; MetalLB for suitable labs; evaluate VPS ServiceLB.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Cloudflare
entries.description: Evaluate DNS/CDN/WAF/proxy, restricted origin and SaaS plan costs.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: TLS
entries.description: Maintain end-to-end TLS and automated certificates after validating domain ownership.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Mongo operator
entries.description: Use the official operator in labs, possibly managed Mongo in production; back up independently.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Kafka operator
entries.description: Use Strimzi in labs, consider managed Kafka subsequently.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Persistent volumes
entries.description: Select CSI/StorageClass by environment and prove backup/restore.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Keycloak and telemetry
entries.description: Run self-managed lab services, evaluate managed alternatives.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Helm
entries.description: Build application charts and per-environment values.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Terraform
entries.description: Manage cloud/external infrastructure, avoiding overlapping GitOps ownership.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Argo CD
entries.description: Reconcile desired Kubernetes state from Git.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Kubernetes secrets
entries.description: Use External Secrets Operator with reference secret manager.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Autoscaling
entries.description: Use metrics-based HPA and later Kafka-backed KEDA only after measurement.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: NetworkPolicies
entries.description: Select a CNI that really enforces policies and test allow/deny behavior.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Cloud costs
entries.description: Use temporary budgeted labs with alerts and teardown checks.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Resilience labs
entries.description: Test pod, node, network, backup, GitOps recovery and rollback.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Tracing
entries.description: Use OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation plus manual spans for commercial transitions.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Trace propagation
entries.description: Use W3C Trace Context for HTTP/Kafka, Span Links when useful, and minimal business correlation.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Sampling
entries.description: Set sampling by environment/criticality; durable saga state never depends on sampled telemetry.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Logs
entries.description: Use Fluent Bit/collector, structured redacted logs and a centralized pipeline.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Elasticsearch
entries.description: Use a shared lab cluster for search and logs, isolating indexes and permissions.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Log retention
entries.description: Use 7–14 days for lab logs, with dataset/environment-specific policies.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Metrics ingestion
entries.description: Use Prometheus scraping and OpenTelemetry sources appropriately.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Dashboards
entries.description: Provide RED/USE, platform, messaging, commerce and security dashboards.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Metric cardinality
entries.description: Control tenant dimensions; never use order/user IDs as global metric labels.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: SLOs
entries.description: Define commercial-journey SLOs formally with benchmarks.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Alerting
entries.description: Use Alertmanager/Grafana with severity, grouping and suppression of duplicate alerts.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Incident prioritization
entries.description: Prioritize impact, error budgets/burn rates and operational symptoms.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Purchase traceability
entries.description: Correlate checkout, Inventory, Stripe, Ordering and Fulfillment with durable identifiers.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Business analytics
entries.description: Use business events and projections rather than logs/metrics/traces as economic authority.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Tenant dashboards
entries.description: Expose only authorized derived metrics; no generic customer access to internal Kibana/Grafana.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately

entries.title: Profiling levels
entries.description: Keep local telemetry light and enable full stack only when necessary.
entries.translationStatus: Reviewed English paraphrase; historical source preserved separately
